competences: The learner reads the transliterated verses of Surat An-Nas.
The learner tells the meanings of the first three verses.
languageCompetence: Pronounces and reads: Surat An-Nas, Qul a'oozu birabbin naas, Malikin naas, Ilaahin naas.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to read the six transliterated verses in order.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to tell the meanings of the first three verses.
priorKnowledge: Learners practised reciting Surat An-Nas during the previous lesson and now connect the sounds to the written transliteration.
methods: I do, we do, you do
materials: Chart showing the six transliterated verses of Surat An-Nas
references: NCDC IRE P.1 TEACHERS RESOURCE BOOK

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher asks learners to recite the surah practised on Tuesday, points to the displayed lines and introduces reading the transliteration. The teacher asks: 'Can you identify Surat An-Nas?'
steps.learnerActivity: Learners look at the displayed chart, name the surah and recall the six verses with the teacher.

source.quote: Display a chart with the Surat

steps.content: Surat An-Nas has six verses; Qul a'oozu birabbin naas; Malikin naas; Ilaahin naas.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher points to the transliterated verses and reads them one at a time, asking learners to follow each word from the displayed chart. The teacher points to the relevant verses on the chart.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners follow the verses on the chart, repeat the words clearly and take turns responding to the teacher.

steps.content: Qul a'oozu birabbin naas; Malikin naas; Ilaahin naas; Min sharril waswaasil khannaas; Allazee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin naas; Minal jinnati wannaas; the Lord, King and God of mankind.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher reads the six verses and explains the sourced meanings of the first three: seeking refuge, the King of mankind, and the God of mankind. The teacher invites learners to practise individually while listening to their pronunciation.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recite or read the verses together and individually, then repeat the words that need clearer articulation.

steps.content: Read Surat An-Nas; Reading Surat An-Nas; Tell the meaning of Surat
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher sets the sourced tasks: 'Read Surat An-Nas', 'Reading Surat An-Nas', and 'Tell the meaning of Surat'. The teacher checks each learner's performance.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners complete the three oral tasks in pairs and individually, repeating the verses and answering the teacher.

source.quote: Reciting the surah (chapter) in groups, pairs and individually

steps.content: I can recite Surat An-Nas; I can read Surat An-Nas.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher invites three learners to recite or read the six verses and asks the class to check the correct order. The teacher gives feedback.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners listen to the three recitations, correct their pronunciation with guidance, and read the verses together.

source.quote: Assess as the learner reads Surat Annas

assessment: Assess learners through the sourced activities 'Read Surat An-Nas', 'Reading Surat An-Nas' and 'Tell the meaning of Surat'. Check correct pronunciation, reading order and understanding.
homework: Practise reciting and reading the six verses of Surat An-Nas each day.
